KXNFL1HWINNER.quote: If Tie is the result at halftime
KXNFL1HWINNER.reason: Three-way first-half result (team A, team B or Tie) of one game at halftime; a period-winner contract generated by first-half scoring of both teams, with tie as an explicit outcome.

KXNFL1QWINNER.quote: the result at the end of the first quarter
KXNFL1QWINNER.reason: Three-way result at end of Q1 (including Tie) of a single game; first-quarter scoring only, the period-winner mechanism with high tie mass given low Q1 scoring.

KXNFL2HWINNER.quote: result of the second half of regulation time
KXNFL2HWINNER.reason: Three-way result of second-half regulation scoring only (overtime excluded by wording); a period-winner contract on 3Q+4Q points, not the full-game result.

KXNFL4QWINNER.quote: result of the fourth quarter of regulation time
KXNFL4QWINNER.reason: Three-way result of fourth-quarter regulation scoring (OT excluded, tie possible); a period winner driven by late-game script, garbage time and comeback urgency.

KXNFLHIGHSCOREQ.quote: is the highest scoring regulation quarter
KXNFLHIGHSCOREQ.reason: Which regulation quarter has the most combined points, OT ignored, ties paid 1/N; a joint comparison of the four quarter totals, i.e. the period-scoring mechanism.

KXNFLNOSCOREQ.quote: collectively score 0 points in any of the 4 regulation quarters
KXNFLNOSCOREQ.reason: YES if any regulation quarter has zero combined points; the lower tail of the four quarter totals, so it belongs with period totals rather than whole-game events.

KXNFLPREPACK1HFT.quote: If Tie is the result at halftime, Seattle wins the game
KXNFLPREPACK1HFT.reason: Pre-packaged halftime/fulltime pair on one game (halftime tie AND Seattle wins); the period archetype explicitly covers halftime-fulltime results, whose legs share one score path.

KXNFL1YDPASS.quote: at least 1 pass attempt from on or inside New England's 1-yard line
KXNFL1YDPASS.reason: Team forward pass attempt snapped from the opponent 1-yard line (sacks/scrambles/runs excluded, penalty-nullified attempts count); a rare play-calling event count driven by goal-line trips and run/pass choice.

KXNFL2PTCONV.quote: collectively convert at least 2 successful 2-point conversions
KXNFL2PTCONV.reason: Combined successful two-point conversions in a game at a 2+ threshold; listed contract type of the counting-specials archetype, driven by TD count times go-for-two decisions.

KXNFL4DCONV.quote: collectively records at least 5 successful 4th down conversions
KXNFL4DCONV.reason: Combined successful 4th-down conversions vs a threshold (5+); a team-stat count driven by coaching aggressiveness, game script and conversion rate, same family as sacks/2-pt counts.

KXNFLGAMESACK.reason: Combined team sacks in a game vs a threshold (9+); sacks are a listed contract type of the counting-specials archetype (pass-rush vs pass-protection count).

KXNFLNONQBPASS.quote: If a non-QB records at least 1 pass attempt
KXNFLNONQBPASS.reason: Any non-quarterback pass attempt by either team; a trick-play event explicitly listed (Non-QB passes) in the counting-specials archetype.

KXNFLLARGELEAD.quote: have a largest lead of between 7 to 10 points
KXNFLLARGELEAD.reason: Largest lead held by either team falls in a 7-10 point bucket; maximum of the score-differential path, explicitly listed as Largest lead in counting specials.

KXNFLLEADCHANGE.quote: collectively record at least 8 lead changes
KXNFLLEADCHANGE.reason: Count of lead changes (first score excluded) reaching 8+; a score-path count statistic, grouped with largest lead in counting specials rather than with winner or total markets.

KXNFLCOMEBACK.quote: must trail by at least the specified point threshold at any point in the game and go on to win
KXNFLCOMEBACK.reason: Either team trails by 24+ at some point and still wins; a rare score-path event (deficit maximum joint with win), closest to the largest-lead specials, not a plain moneyline.

KXNFLGAMETD.reason: Combined touchdowns by both teams at a 9+ threshold in one game; the game TD-count event that game_events targets (total TDs), not a player scorer market.

KXNFLFIRSTTDTIME.quote: record the first touchdown in the overtime period
KXNFLFIRSTTDTIME.reason: Game-time bucket in which the first touchdown is scored (here: overtime); the first-TD time component of the first-score archetype.

KXNFLCOMBO.quote: All Components must resolve to yes for this market to resolve to Yes.
KXNFLCOMBO.reason: Super Bowl same-game parlay of player prop legs (passing yards, receptions, TDs, rushing yards), all must hit; joint-probability combo of correlated player outcomes.

KXNFLPREPACK.quote: All outcomes encompassed in a market must occur for the market to resolve Yes.
KXNFLPREPACK.reason: Pre-packed same-game parlay: moneyline winner AND game total under 46.5 for one game; joint resolution of correlated game legs is the combo mechanism.

KXNFLPREPACK2ML.quote: New England wins against Denver, Seattle wins against Los Angeles R
KXNFLPREPACK2ML.reason: Two-game moneyline parlay across different games (both winners must hit); cross-game combo whose joint probability is near product of leg win probabilities.

KXNFLPREPACK3ML.quote: San Francisco wins against Seattle, Denver wins against Buffalo
KXNFLPREPACK3ML.reason: Three-game moneyline parlay across playoff games, all legs must win; a multi-leg combo archetype member.

KXNFLPROBOWL.quote: If the NFC wins the 2026 Pro Bowl flag football game
KXNFLPROBOWL.reason: Winner of the official NFL Pro Bowl flag-football exhibition (NFC vs AFC); NFL players in a league event so kept in scope, but low-effort flag format differs sharply from regular games.

KXNFLDEPTHPOSITIONCLEQB2.quote: officially designated as Cleveland's QB2 for Week 1
KXNFLDEPTHPOSITIONCLEQB2.reason: Named player listed as QB2 on the team's official Week 1 depth chart (fallback team communications; injured but listed still YES); a role-designation contract within player availability.

KXNFLEXACTWINSTB.quote: has exactly 9 wins in the 2025-26 regular season
KXNFLEXACTWINSTB.reason: Exact regular-season win count (ties not wins) for one team; a season win-total bucket generated by the 17-game season outcome distribution.

KXNFLWINS-NO.quote: has more than 9 wins in the 2025-26 regular season
KXNFLWINS-NO.reason: Regular-season wins over 9 (ties excluded) for New Orleans; a season win-total threshold, the core season-futures mechanism.

KXNFLRECYDSRECORD.quote: must finish the regular season with more than 1,964 receiving yards
KXNFLRECYDSRECORD.reason: Player must exceed the 1,964-yard single-season receiving record (ties do not count) over the regular season; a season stat threshold driven by cumulative yards and games played.

KXNFLSACKRECORD.quote: must finish the regular season with more than 22.5 sacks
KXNFLSACKRECORD.reason: Player must exceed 22.5 regular-season sacks (record; ties do not count); a cumulative season-stat threshold for an edge rusher, not an award vote.

KXNFLFANTASYMOST.quote: based on ESPN's FFL Points Per Reception (PPR) scoring
KXNFLFANTASYMOST.reason: Which player has most ESPN PPR fantasy points in one game, ties paid 1/N; a game-level fantasy points argmax, the existing fantasy archetype.

KXNFLLONGESTTD.quote: record a longest touchdown of 51 yards or more
KXNFLLONGESTTD.reason: Longest touchdown play in one game at 51+ yards (play-by-play yards, no TD resolves NO); a maximum over TD play lengths, the extreme-play-length archetype.

KXNFLSHORTESTTD.quote: record a shortest touchdown between 6 and 10 yards
KXNFLSHORTESTTD.reason: Shortest touchdown in the game falls in 6-10 yards (inclusive; no TD resolves NO); minimum of TD play lengths, the extreme-play-length archetype.

KXNFLSBMVP.quote: wins the 2025-26 Pro Football Championship Game MVP
KXNFLSBMVP.reason: Named player wins Super Bowl MVP; single-game award driven by which team wins and the standout box-score performer, the declared super_bowl_mvp archetype.

KXNFLSBMVPPOS.quote: If any WR/TE wins the 2025-26 Pro Football Championship Game MVP
KXNFLSBMVPPOS.reason: Position group (WR/TE) of the Super Bowl MVP per league depth chart, multiple strikes can hit; positional aggregation of the same SB MVP award process.

KXNFLHIRECOACH.quote: is hired as a coach in men's pro football before Jan 1, 2026
KXNFLHIRECOACH.reason: Named person hired as a coach before a deadline; a coaching transaction per announcement. 'Men's pro football' could include non-NFL leagues, a scope ambiguity noted.

KXNFLSUPDRAFTPICK.quote: declares for the Pro Football Supplemental Draft
KXNFLSUPDRAFTPICK.reason: Player's own announced declaration for the Supplemental Draft before July 15; an eligibility/transaction decision by the player, not a team selection, so off-field event rather than draft selection.

KXNFLDRAFT1.quote: is selected as the Pro Football First overall pick
KXNFLDRAFT1.reason: Exact first overall pick of the Draft for a named prospect; draft slot outcome from team board, need and trades. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTCAT.quote: players are drafted in the entire draft
KXNFLDRAFTCAT.reason: Count of a school's players drafted across the whole Draft (9+ Texas) per league college classification; aggregated draft selection outcome. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTCOMPARE.quote: is the school with the most players selected in rounds 1, 2, and 3
KXNFLDRAFTCOMPARE.reason: School with most players drafted in rounds 1-3, ties paid 1/N; an argmax over draft selection counts by college. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTDB.quote: is the 3rd Defensive Back (Cornerback or Safety) drafted
KXNFLDRAFTDB.reason: Named prospect is the Nth defensive back drafted (league position designation); positional draft order outcome. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTDT.reason: Named prospect is the 2nd defensive tackle selected; positional draft order generated by team boards and need. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTEDGE.reason: Named prospect is the 4th edge rusher selected; positional draft order per league position. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTLB.reason: Named prospect is the 3rd linebacker selected; positional draft order outcome of the Draft. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTMATCHUP.quote: is drafted 1st between Diego Pavia or Cade Klubnik
KXNFLDRAFTMATCHUP.reason: Which of two named prospects is drafted first; a pairwise draft order comparison. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTOL.quote: is the 3rd Offensive Lineman (Offensive Tackle, Guard, or Center) drafted
KXNFLDRAFTOL.reason: Named prospect is the 3rd offensive lineman selected; positional draft order outcome. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTOU.quote: is drafted in the first 64 picks
KXNFLDRAFTOU.reason: Named prospect selected within the first 64 picks; draft-position over/under for one prospect. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTRB.reason: Named prospect is the 3rd running back selected; positional draft order outcome. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTTE.reason: Named prospect is the 3rd tight end selected; positional draft order outcome. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTTEAM.quote: Trades made during or after the draft do not affect resolution
KXNFLDRAFTTEAM.reason: Named prospect drafted by a named team (selecting team counts, undrafted resolves NO); team-prospect draft match. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTTEAMPOS.quote: selects any quarterback in Rounds 1, 2, or 3
KXNFLDRAFTTEAMPOS.reason: Whether a team selects a quarterback in rounds 1-3; team positional draft decision. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLDRAFTWR.reason: Named prospect is the 5th wide receiver selected; positional draft order outcome. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLLASTPICKPOS.quote: resolves based on the last player selected
KXNFLLASTPICKPOS.reason: Position of the final selection of the Draft (here WR) per league designation; draft selection outcome at the last pick. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLTEAM1POS.quote: select any Wide Receiver with their 1st pick
KXNFLTEAM1POS.reason: Position of a team's first selection in the Draft (WR for Washington); team positional draft decision. Settled by official Draft results; fits the declared nfl_draft_selection archetype.

KXNFLCOMBINE.quote: record a broad jump of at least 148 inches at the 2026 Pro Football Draft Combine
KXNFLCOMBINE.reason: Max broad jump among all Combine participants at 148+ inches; an extreme of prospect athletic testing at the league's official Combine, not a draft pick or game stat.

KXNFLCOMBINE40.quote: records the fastest 40-yard dash time in the 2026 Pro Football Draft Combine
KXNFLCOMBINE40.reason: Named prospect posts the fastest Combine 40-yard dash; argmax of timed testing among participants, depends on who elects to run plus speed distribution.

KXNFLCELEBRITYGAME.quote: PrizePicks Creator Games consist of three pre-game events
KXNFLCELEBRITYGAME.reason: Winner of PrizePicks Creator Games: eight content creators scored on 40-yard dash, throw distance and push-ups; no NFL players or league decision, entertainment exhibition.

combine_testing_results.label: NFL Scouting Combine athletic testing results
contract_types: Pro Football Draft Combine: Longest Broad Jump
Pro Football Draft Combine: Player with Fastest 40 Time
combine_testing_results.target: Probability that the best Combine measurement in a drill (40-yard dash, broad jump) clears a threshold or belongs to a named prospect, per official Combine results.
combine_testing_results.why_distinct: Outcome is generated by prospect athleticism and each prospect's choice to test (opt-outs, pro-day deferral), an extreme over participants; no draft-board, game, season-stat or award process produces it, and nfl_draft_selection settles on picks, not measurements.

out_of_scope_categories.entertainment_exhibitions: Celebrity or creator exhibitions whose participants are not NFL players competing in NFL events; the outcome is entertainment, not NFL performance or an official NFL decision.
